notes.title: September 26th 2025: Beta Update
notes.notes:
[p]        I can't believe how far this game has come in the past year, and that it's nearing release-ready. All of the contributions from the playtesters have made a huge difference. This update addresses some long-standing bugs that I was able to figure out with the help from those testers. There are more to solve, but this build feels like the game is getting into great shape.[/p][p][/p][h3]NEW:[/h3][p]Added a credits button to the out-of-game Options menu.[/p][p]Added an End-Game state to the Mission Table.[/p][p]Added VFX to the Thrall’s shield break.[/p][h3]
UPDATES:[/h3][p]Updated existing Mission Thumbnails, and created new graphics to replace the temporary images used for Stone Rise and Delver City.[/p][p]Replaced all the button graphics to address a subtle but annoying flash of color that would happen when opening and closing popups.[/p][p]Synced the Loading screen and Loading Transition colors to create a smooth and seamless transition.[/p][p]Smoothed the Mission Table’s zoom in and out animations.[/p][p]Updated + Added new VFX to the Abhorration boss, including banking rotation when it turns. Thought it looked cool.[/p][p]Updated the path arrow to have more directionality in its texture.[/p][h3]
FIXES:[/h3][p]Fixed an issue where the cells a structure occupies could be entered by Grainwraith if you hover over the Sell button.[/p][p]Addressed some invalid references in the Player Data and Gatherer Controller.[/p][p]Addressed a bug where the Gatherer may go unresponsive if its assigned resource node is harvested.[/p][p]Fixed icky Obelisk range line rendering.[/p][p]Fixed multiple issues with the Abhorration’s movement sequences / decision making.[/p][p]Blueprint Towers now properly appear and dissolve the same way as other structures.[/p][p][/p][p]GLHF![/p][p]-Jim[/p]

notes.title: September 17th 2025: Beta Update
notes.notes: [p]        The game’s nearing release. A lot of my focus is on improving what is existing, and adding smaller quality of life features, and what remains of my focus and energy is going into marketing the game. I appreciate everyone’s time and attention spent on Spires of Morosith, finding bugs and calling them out, providing feedback on their experiences, and sharing the game with others. I still need the help, please don’t let up![/p][p][/p][h3]NEW:[/h3][p]Added 5 cursor sizes to choose from in the Options menu.[/p][p]Added Screen Resolution options when playing in Window or Borderless Window mode.[/p][p]Added Walls and Paths to Spires to help convey the Spire’s entrance points.[/p][p]Added Indicators when constructing buildings that appear near the Spire when a building would block access to a Spire entrance.[/p][p]Added VFX to Survival Tears.[/p][p]All Standard mission Tears now display which wave they’ll start spawning on.[/p][p]Added an Ancient Knowledge tutorial on mission 1 - 2.[/p][p]Reset Progress button removed from the World Map screen. (Let me know if you need a reset, I can help out)[/p][p][/p][h3]UPDATES:[/h3][p]Stone Rise and Delver City missions now have their own music tracks.[/p][p]Towers and Structures are now muted while the game is paused.[/p][p]Adjusted many Forest positions on Missions 3 and 4.[/p][p]Updated Wave Complete and Wave Starting sound effects.[/p][p]Spores in Delver City will now shoot ooze when 2 structures are built near them, down from 3.[/p][p]Updated the Build, Sell, and Upgrade tower VFX and SFX.[/p][p]Playing Mission 1 - 1 and 1 - 2 on Morosith’s Challenge mode will skip their tutorials.[/p][p]Updated the Play/Pause/FFW SFX.[/p][p]Adjusted the Gatherer Level Up SFX.[/p][p][/p][h3]FIXES:[/h3][p]Final upgrades for towers renamed from Nobel to Noble.[/p][p]The frame at the top of a Mission Info popup now correctly adjusts when Challenge Mode’s icon is present.[/p][p]Removed Highest Wave + Perfect Waves text from unbeaten missions on the World Map.[/p][p]First Mission correctly progresses the quests if you shift+queue to command the Gatherer instead of just Mouse2.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the Conduits cost 4 extra wood.[/p][p]Fixed broken text for the Gem Tower tooltips.[/p][p]Fixed the broken Spire repair UI in Survival missions.[/p][p]Removed duplicate / broken forests from a few missions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p]-Jim[/p]

notes.title: Spires of Morosith Demo Update, Chinese, Russian, German support added!
notes.notes:
[p]Good afternoon![/p][p]I've updated the game's demo today with a good chunk of bug fixing and some new features! I've been wanting to surface some more information that could be helpful, or exciting, in a few different interfaces. And there were some quality of life controls I wanted to add in.
[/p][p][b]Bestiary[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shows some base stats for the Grainwraith, the discovered types, and the bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Each entry is a  "???" until the cutscene introducing them is displayed. To that, people that have already played past the cutscenes wont have those Grainwraiths displayed unless they play the corresponding mission again.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]World Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now click to speed past the zoom-in animation sequence, and improved a little bit of the responsiveness of opening the Mission Info popups.[/p][/*][*][p]Mission Info now displays the region, region number, map number, and map name. 
[i]Example:[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Arborglen 1 - 1 [/i][/p][p][i]First Spire.[/i][/p][p]This info is now also on the Mission Victory/Defeat screens.[/p][list][*][p]Mission info now displays the number of Ancient Knowledge discoveries there are left in the mission.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mission Results UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Mission Victory/Defeat screens display more information and present your Wave Complete Stars in a nice little animation.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mission Victory/Dfeat screen has a button in the top left that will hide/show the screen, allowing you a more clear picture of the defense you've created.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gatherers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gatherers queueing system upgraded to now support queueing Ancient Knowledge. If used, you can bypass the awkward 'Knowledge now reachable, select the gatherer, tell the gatherer to get the knowledge, then wake the gatherer back up to work'.[/p][/*][*][p]Shift + RMB on Trees and Knowledge to queue them. (Doing so a second time will remove them from the queue)[/p][/*][*][p]Gatherers no longer auto-harvest Deadroot after depleting a Heartwood node.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to right-click a resource node a gatherer is working on, to tell them to stop harvesting it.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed a couple Portal bugs that would incorrectly prohibit you from building towers.[/p][/*][*][p]Gave Yaks and Spores some tooltips, (Post-localization, so these have no strings yet)[/p][/*][*][p]Yaks should no longer be able to float across the sky to other islands.[/p][/*][*][p]Messed with the Menu screen a little bit, trying some new stuff out.[/p][/*][*][p]Display settings now properly saved and applied between game launches.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]
